questions.question: Find the manager name and district of the shop whose number of products is the largest.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT manager_name ,  district FROM shop ORDER BY number_products DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What are the minimum and maximum number of products across all the shops?
Find the names of stores whose number products is more than the average number of products.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM shop WHERE number_products  >  (SELECT avg(number_products) FROM shop)

questions.question: What is the name of the shop that is hiring the largest number of employees?
questions.gold_sql: SELECT t2.name FROM hiring AS t1 JOIN shop AS t2 ON t1.shop_id  =  t2.shop_id GROUP BY t1.shop_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which shops run with no employees? Find the shop names
questions.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM shop WHERE shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shop_id FROM hiring)

questions.question: Find the total amount of bonus given in all the evaluations.
Find the districts in which there are both shops selling less than 3000 products and shops selling more than 10000 products.
questions.gold_sql: SELECT district FROM shop WHERE Number_products  <  3000 INTERSECT SELECT district FROM shop WHERE Number_products  >  10000
